content.text: {"id": "mm5745a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Age-standardized COPD mortality rates remained fairly stable during the period overall but decreased among men and increased among women."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Annual age-, sex-, and race-specific rates (per 100,000 population) of death from COPD during 2000--2005 were computed"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2005, the death rate among white men was 80.2 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 79.5--80.9)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The death rate was higher for men compared with the rate for women in each year"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "From 2000 to 2005, the annual number of deaths from COPD increased 5% among men"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "For each year during 2000--2005, COPD mortality rates were higher among whites than among blacks or persons of all other races."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "using the 2000 U.S. standard population aged > 25 years for direct age standardization"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS)."}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "From 2000 to 2005, the annual number of deaths from COPD increased 5% among men"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "computed by dividing the number of COPD deaths by midyear population estimates"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "using the 2000 U.S. standard population aged > 25 years for direct age standardization"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Rate calculations were restricted to adults aged > 25 years because this group accounted for 99.9% of all COPD deaths."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
